Package chessphase2

Class GameState

java.lang.Object
chessphase2.GameState
public final class GameState extends Object
Stores the complete Phase 2 game state independently of Swing. Piece-specific chess movement validation is intentionally not applied.

      public MoveRecord move(int fromRow, int fromCol, int toRow, int toCol)
      Moves the active player's piece to an empty square or a square occupied by an opponent. Chess-specific movement restrictions are not checked.
      Parameters:
      fromRow - starting row
      fromCol - starting column
      toRow - destination row
      toCol - destination column
      Returns:
      a record of the completed move
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for an empty start, wrong player, or own-piece capture
